tools.name: binary_cube_analyze_subcube_damage
tools.description: Damage each indexed subcube region and compare strict rejection with bounded tolerant recovery, including corrected-share counts and silent-corruption detection.

maxCorrections.description: Maximum share errors corrected per logical codeword; defaults to floor((fanOut-1)/2).

tools.name: binary_cube_compare_subcube_damage
tools.description: Compare strict and bounded-tolerant localized region-damage behavior across fan-outs 1, 3, 5, and 7 using safe per-fan-out correction limits.
